{{Quote|The Black Nemesis?! Yes, I have briefly heard of such a 'ghost' a long time ago. Yes, indeed. Even in the information you retrieved off the Black Suns it was mentioned about a mysterious fighter in the Ghost Tide. It is time to act against this so-called Black Nemesis!|[[Kelen Wordkal]]|<ref name="SWG:TBDE" />}}
The '''Black Nemesis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Black Nemesis attacked [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] with his [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter]]. The pirate was eventually killed by pilots of the [[Mos Eisley Police Authority|Mos Eisley Police]].<ref name="SWG:TBDE" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempGenericPirate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of the Black Nemesis]]
The Black Nemesis appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TBDE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Black Nemesis was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:TBDE" />
